title: Pure Black Luster Soldier
summary: The classic Super Soldier Ritual engine combined with the 2026 Light and Darkness Ritual support wave, Ragged Records of Rites, and generic staples. The page's Red Dragon Archfiend and Branded variants are left out, and the official TCG names are used for the 2026 cards.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gateway to Chaos searches any Black Luster Soldier Ritual Monster or Gaia the Fierce Knight monster on activation, and removes 3 Spell Counters to search any Ritual Spell.

Ragged Records of Rites reveals a Ritual Spell in the hand to search a Ritual Monster whose name is listed on it, finding Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness, Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos, or Black Luster Soldier - Super Soldier.

Griffoh discards itself to Set a Quick-Play Spell or Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual (such as Mind Shuffle), and can fulfill the entire Level 8 Tribute requirement for a LIGHT or DARK Ritual Summon.
Skull Archfiend of Chaos sends a Ritual Spell from the Deck to the GY when sent to the GY to search a Ritual Monster mentioned on that Spell.

summary.title: Opening: Gateway to Chaos + Super Soldier Synthesis
steps: Activate Gateway to Chaos to search Black Luster Soldier - Super Soldier or Black Luster Soldier - Legendary Swordsman.

Activate Super Soldier Synthesis to Ritual Summon the Black Luster Soldier from your hand or GY by sending Beginning Knight from the hand and Evening Twilight Knight from the Deck (or vice versa) to the GY.

The Ritual Monster gains both Knights' bonus effects (banishing a monster on the field and banishing a card from the opponent's hand), while Light and Darkness Ritual and Griffoh deploy Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness alongside it.

summary.title: Knight Materials & 2026 Light and Darkness Engine
summary.text: Beginning Knight and Evening Twilight Knight grant extra banish effects to any Black Luster Soldier Ritual Summoned using them, and when banished from the GY (for Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning or Super Soldier Soul), they search a Ritual Spell and a Ritual Monster respectively. The 2026 wave adds Light and Darkness Ritual, which Ritual Summons Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness or Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos and recovers itself from the GY each turn, plus the Main Deck monster Black Chaos, which shuffles a Ritual Monster from your field or GY back into the Deck to Special Summon itself and banish 2 cards.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness banishes a card on the field when Ritual Summoned, cannot be destroyed by battle, and can make a second attack each Battle Phase.

Black Luster Soldier - Legendary Swordsman locks the opponent out of activating cards or effects during your Battle Phase and shuffles all cards they control into the Deck when it destroys a monster by battle.

Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos recovers a Spell from the GY and banishes a card on the field face-down, while Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Chaos (Link-3) becomes untargetable and indestructible by card effects when made with a Level 7 or higher monster.
Mind Shuffle searches a monster that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual and tags your Ritual Monster into another on the opponent's turn, while Super Soldier Shield negates targeting effects.

main: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness
2026 support. Ritual: banishes a card when summoned, can't be destroyed by battle, and attacks twice.
Black Luster Soldier - Legendary Swordsman
Ritual: trades your draw for a Ritual Spell; their cards can't respond in your Battle Phase.
Black Luster Soldier - Super Soldier
Ritual for Super Soldier Ritual or Synthesis: burns for what it destroys.
Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos
2026 Ritual: returns a Spell and banishes a card face-down.
Black Chaos
2026 support. Shuffles a Ritual Monster back to summon itself; banishes two cards.
Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
Banishes a LIGHT and a DARK from the GY to summon itself; banishes a monster.
Beginning Knight
LIGHT Synthesis material: gives a banish; banished from the GY, searches a Ritual Spell.
Evening Twilight Knight
DARK Synthesis material: gives a banish; banished from the GY, searches a Ritual Monster.
Super Soldier Soul
Becomes a 3000 ATK Black Luster Soldier; banished, searches a Knight.
Griffoh
2026 support. Pays a whole Level 8 Ritual alone; discards to Set a Light and Darkness Quick-Play or Trap.
Skull Archfiend of Chaos
2026 support. Revives itself; sent to the GY, mills a Ritual Spell to search its Ritual Monster.
Gateway to Chaos
Field Spell: searches a Black Luster Soldier Ritual, then a Ritual Spell with counters.
Super Soldier Synthesis
Ritual Spell: sends a LIGHT and a DARK totalling Level 8, one from the Deck.
Super Soldier Ritual
Ritual Spell; from the GY, summons a Black Luster Soldier Ritual.
Light and Darkness Ritual
2026 Ritual Spell for the new Soldier and Black Chaos; returns itself each turn.
Ragged Records of Rites
Generic: reveals a Ritual Spell to search a monster it names.
Mind Shuffle
2026 support. Searches a monster that names the Ritual, and tags them in on their turn.
Super Soldier Shield
Counter Trap with a Black Luster Soldier out: negates a targeting effect.
extra: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Chaos
Link-3 with a Level 7+ Ritual: can't be targeted or destroyed, and banishes after battles.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
